hello.title: 👋 Welcome to Balce, {name}!
hello.body: This short tour shows you around. It takes about a minute. You can skip it, and open it again any time from your account menu.

menu.title: 🧭 Your menu
menu.body: Everything lives here: selling, products, stock, reports and settings. On a phone, open it with the ☰ button at the top.

pos.title: 🛒 Point of Sale
pos.body: Sell here. Search or scan a product, add it to the cart and take payment.

products.title: 📦 Products
products.body: Add what you sell. Pick from the ready list of common products to save time.

users.title: 👥 Users
users.body: Give each cashier their own sign in, so every sale shows who served.

settings.title: ⚙️ Settings
settings.body: Add your logo, phone and receipt text, and switch on extras such as credit (madeni), suppliers and books.

language.title: 🌍 Language
language.body: Switch between English and Kiswahili at any time.

notifications.title: 🔔 Notifications
notifications.body: Low stock and other alerts appear here.

account.title: 👤 Your account
account.body: Settings, help from the Balce team, and this tour again are all here.

start.title: 🚀 Let's get you selling
start.body:
Three steps to start:
1. Settings — your business details
2. Products — what you sell
3. Users — your cashiers
Each page shows a short guide the first time you open it.

tabs.title: 🗂️ Settings sections
tabs.body: Each tab covers one area. Start with Business, then work along the tabs.

business.title: 🏪 Business details
business.body: Your business name, phone, address and TIN print on receipts and invoices. Press Save when you are done.

features.title: 🧩 Features
features.body: Switch on only what your shop needs: customers and credit (madeni), orders, suppliers, money and books. You can change this any time.

branding.title: 🎨 Branding
branding.body: Upload your logo. It prints on receipts, invoices and reports.

hardware.title: 🖨️ Printer and scanner
hardware.body: Connect a receipt printer and test it here.

add.title: ➕ Add a product
add.body: Add items one by one. In the form, “Pick from common products” fills in the name, unit, category and price for you.

import.title: 📥 Import from Excel
import.body: Already have a list? Press Template, fill it in Excel, then Import to add everything at once.

search.title: 🔍 Find a product
search.body: Search by name, SKU or barcode, or filter by category.

next.title: ✅ Ready to sell
next.body: Products with stock appear at the Point of Sale straight away. Change quantities later under Stock.

search.title: 🔍 Find or scan
search.body: Type a name or scan a barcode. Press Enter to add the first match.

products.title: 👆 Tap to add
products.body: Tap a product to put it in the cart. Tap again to add one more.

carts.title: 🛍️ Serve several customers
carts.body: Keep up to three carts open and switch between them while a customer decides.

pay.title: 💵 Take payment
pay.body: Press Pay, choose cash, card or mobile money, and print the receipt.

add.title: ➕ Add a user
add.body: Give each cashier their own sign in with Add User. Every sale then shows who served, and nobody shares a password.

list.title: 👥 Your team
list.body: Everyone who can sign in is listed here. Change a role, reset a password or switch someone off when they leave. Their past sales stay.

roles.title: 🛡️ Roles
roles.body: A role decides what a person may do: sell only, manage stock, see reports. Set roles up once, then pick one for each user.

what.title: 🛡️ What roles do
what.body: A role is a set of permissions. A cashier role might only sell; a manager role might also change stock and see reports. The owner can always do everything.

add.title: ➕ Add a role
add.body: Name the role, then tick what it may do. Keep it simple: most shops need just Cashier and Manager.

list.title: 📋 Your roles
list.body: Open a role to change its permissions. The change applies to everyone with that role the next time they sign in.

add.title: 🏬 Add a branch
add.body: Opening another branch? Add it here. Each shop keeps its own stock, sales and receipt numbers.

list.title: 🧾 Receipt prefix
list.body: Each shop's receipts start with its prefix, such as SALE or KRK, so you can tell at a glance which branch a receipt came from.

switch.title: 🔀 Switch shop
switch.body: Work in another branch by choosing it from your account menu. Reports can show one shop or all shops together.

change.title: ✏️ Change stock
change.body: Counted the shelf and found a different number, or something broke or expired? Use Change stock and give a reason. Every change is kept in History.

arrived.title: 📦 Stock arrived
arrived.body: When goods come in, record them here. The quantity goes up and the buying price is kept, so profit stays correct.

send.title: 🚚 Send stock
send.body: Move stock to another branch. It leaves this shop now and arrives when the other shop confirms it.

tabs.title: 🗂️ Levels and history
tabs.body: Levels shows what is on the shelves now. History shows every sale, arrival and change, with who did it.

add.title: 🙋 Add a customer
add.body: Save regular customers with their phone number. You can pick them at the till to sell on credit (madeni) or keep their history.

owing.title: 💳 Who owes
owing.body: See everyone who owes you and for how long. Open a customer to take a payment, send a reminder or share their statement.

credit.title: 🧾 Selling on credit
credit.body: At the till, add the customer to the cart and pay with On credit. The amount goes onto their debt until they pay.

add.title: 📝 New order
add.body: Take an order for something a customer will collect later, with or without a deposit.

tabs.title: 🔄 Order stages
tabs.body: Orders move from Waiting to Ready to Collected. When the customer collects, the sale is finished at the till.

arrived.title: 📦 Stock arrived
arrived.body: Record goods from a supplier with their invoice. Stock goes up and what you owe the supplier is kept.

pay.title: 💵 Pay a supplier
pay.body: Record a payment and it comes off what you owe them. Cash, mobile money or bank.

tabs.title: 🗂️ Suppliers, deliveries and payments
tabs.body: Each tab keeps one list. Open a supplier to see their statement, ready to compare with theirs.

intro.title: 💰 Money
intro.body: Record money that does not come from sales here: rent, salaries, LUKU, money the owner puts in or takes out, and moves between cash, mobile money and bank. Sales are recorded for you.

out.title: 💸 Money out
out.body: Paid for something? Press Money out, choose what it was for (rent, salaries, transport…), where the money came from, and add a photo of the receipt if you have one.

other.title: ➕ Other records
other.body: Money the owner brought in or took out, money moved from cash to the bank, or other money that came in.

table.title: 📋 Every record
table.body: Everything recorded in the chosen period, newest first. Open a record to see its details or reverse a mistake.

more.title: 📑 Reports and more
more.body: Open Reports for profit and loss, the cash book and more. With full books you also find the books check, the chart of accounts and month closing here.

filters.title: 📅 Choose the period
filters.body: Pick a period and a shop. Every report below follows these choices.

list.title: 📚 Every report in one place
list.body: Sales, stock, customers and suppliers, and your financial statements, all in one list.

preview.title: 👀 Preview, print or save
preview.body: Preview opens the finished document. Print it, or save it as Excel or PDF to send to your accountant or bank.

today.title: 📊 Today at a glance
today.body: Today's sales and profit compared with yesterday, this month so far, and stock that needs attention.

checklist.title: ✅ Getting started
checklist.body: A short list of what to set up. Each item opens the right page, and it ticks itself off when done.

add.title: 🏷️ New discount
add.body: Create a discount for a product, a category or the whole sale, as a percentage or an amount, with start and end dates if you like.

how.title: 🛒 At the till
how.body: Running discounts apply at the till by themselves. Stop one any time and it no longer applies.

search.title: 🔍 Find a sale
search.body: Search by receipt number or pick dates to see past sales.

list.title: 🧾 Sales history
list.body: Every sale with its receipt number, who served and how the customer paid.

refund.title: ↩️ Reprint or void
refund.body: Open a sale to see its items, print the receipt again, or void it if it was a mistake. A voided sale stays in the list, marked Voided.
